objective_value: <float> Total cost of opening the chosen hubs plus routing all commodities through them.
open_hubs: <list[int]> Node ids selected to be opened as hub facilities.

assignments.commodity: <int> Index of the commodity being routed.
assignments.origin: <int> Origin node id of the commodity.
assignments.destination: <int> Destination node id of the commodity.
assignments.hub_edge: <list[int], length 1 or 2> Hub or unordered pair of hubs through which this commodity is routed (length 1 means the commodity passes through a single hub).
assignments.cost: <float> Transportation cost incurred for routing this commodity through the assigned hub edge.
